last_commit_summary: Added open-sided (no wall framing/cladding) and no-floor options to the Shed Model Builder: a new floorType 'none', an openSides toggle that swaps wall framing/cladding for support posts and bracing in the item list and swaps the solid wall box for corner posts in the 3D model, and development-pathway flags noting open-sided structures still face the same exempt/complying development checks.
blocker: Live Bunnings stock and pricing still require approved partner API credentials before runtime access can be enabled.
